full_judgment: 8. The learned Additional Attorney General produced before us the gazette notification dated 23rd September, 1986 and submitted that the land concerned in the suit appears in the list of abandoned property list for Pabna District under serial No. 1 Mouza-Patila Khali, Khatian-154, Plot No. 1139 and the quantum of land is shown as .0850 acre. However, from the materials before us there is no way of ascertaining that the land concerned in Money Suit No. 22 of 1986 is in fact the land pointed out by the learned Additional Attorney General in the abandoned property list for District-Pabna as aforesaid. Moreover, we find from the judgment of the trial Court that it was noted that A.P. Case No. 106/73-74 (which the learned Additional Attorney General submits should be read as A.P. Case No. 126/73-74) was the subject matter of Title Suit No. 47 of 1983 in the Court of Munsef, First Court, Pabna filed by its owner Nazrul Hossain, which was decreed in favour of the plaintiff and that decree was upheld in Other Class Appeal No. 29 of 1984 and Civil Revision No. 350 of 1984. The property was handed over to the owner through Court. It is therefore apparent from the above that Nazrul Hossain the original owner of the property in question challenged the inclusion of the property in the list of abandoned properties by filing Title Suit No. 47 of 1983 and obtained a decree in his favour. The property was handed over to the owner through Court. Hence, according to proviso (a) to section 5(1) of the Abandoned Buildings (Supplementary Provision) Ordinance, 1985 the property was not liable to be included in the list of abandoned property.
